entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana. I'm calling about the VeloBand Cadence Sensor I bought. I've had it for almost two weeks, and I'm finding it surprisingly hard to use.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with it. I can definitely look into this for you. To make sure I understand, is it a technical fault with the device, or more of a preference issue?
It's a preference thing. I've read the user manual a couple of times, but the whole interface feels confusing. To be honest, I expected more from it. It's not as intuitive as I'd hoped.
I see. It's important that you're happy with your purchase. Can I get your order number or the email address you used to purchase?

Sure, the email is cyclist.pro@email.com. Since I'm a couple of days past that initial 10-day period I saw mentioned, I was hoping we could maybe work something out? A small store credit or something similar?
Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order. It was delivered 12 days ago on December 26th. And let me just check our policy for you.
Right, I'm just hoping for a bit of flexibility.
Actually, there's no need for that. You are well within our return window. Our policy allows for returns on items for up to 90 days after delivery.
Oh, really? Ninety days? I must have misread something. That's... great. So I can just return it for a full refund?

That's correct. A full refund, no problem at all. I am generating a pre-paid return shipping label and I've just sent it to your email. Please pack the sensor in its original box, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any post office.
Wow, that was much easier than I expected. Thank you so much, Diana.
You're very welcome. Once our warehouse receives the item, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's everything. Thanks again for your help.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
